.._comment_include_component_in_tag: Manifest mode tags as <component>-v<version> by default. release.yml triggers on tags: ['v*'], so a prefixed tag would never fire the builder. Verified by dry-run: tagName v0.0.0, not edg-v0.0.0.
.._comment_initial_version: release-please treats 'no existing tag' as an initial release and defaults to 1.0.0; bump-minor-pre-major only applies to bumps from an existing version, so it does not help here. Verified by dry-run: without this the first release is proposed as 1.0.0.
